verdict.rationale: Ollama is a local inference runtime, so CPU-architecture support is a fair axis. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions PowerPC, RISC-V, s390x or any CPU architecture beyond the platforms implied by the macOS/Linux/Windows install and GPU discussion. With no documented support for non-x86/ARM CPUs, the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run inference on diverse CPU architectures beyond x86 and ARM, such as PowerPC
